item.title: Man who stole two English Bulldog puppies in Centennial sentenced to 8 years in prison
item.description: A man who stole two English Bulldog puppies from a pet store in Centennial was sentenced Monday to eight years behind bars.

item.title: Denver City Council approves $325,000 settlement in excessive force case involving sheriff’s deputy
item.description: Denver City Council has approved a $325,000 settlement in an excessive use of force case that took place nearly seven years ago and involved a Denver Sheriff Department deputy.

item.title: Colorado Democrats announce legislation they claim will hold federal immigration agents accountable
item.description: On the heels of protests that erupted across the nation related to federal immigration enforcement in Minnesota, Colorado Democrats announced legislation they contend will protect civil rights.
